parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance name. This parameter is used for exact match filtering. Separate multiple instance names with commas (,).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The instance description. This parameter supports fuzzy match.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: If you do not specify this parameter or specify a value less than 10, the default value is 10. If you specify a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.
